simple.meaning: שִׁבְעָתַיִם (shibʻâthayim) is a Hebrew word meaning “seven-times.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H7659. shibathayim שִׁבְעָתַ֫יִם noun feminine dual seven-fold, seven times (compare Ges §§ 97h , 134r); — 1 seven-fold, seven times as much , Isa 30:26 ; Prov 6:31 ; as adverb Gen 4:15 , 24 ; Psa 79:12 . 2 seven times , adverb Psa 12:7 . — 2Sam 21:9 read Qr שְׁבַעְתָּם see I. שֶׁבַע .

occurrences.englishText: Yahweh said to him, “Therefore whoever slays Cain, vengeance will be taken on him sevenfold.” Yahweh appointed a sign for Cain, so that anyone finding him would not strike him.
If Cain will be avenged seven times,
Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom
but if he is found, he shall restore seven times.

Moreover the light of the moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times brighter, like the light of seven days, in the day that Yahweh binds up the fracture of his people, and heals the wound they were struck with.
